doc: `det` is an `AlternatingMap` in the rows of the matrix.
statement: {n : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq n] → [Fintype n] → {R : Type v} → [inst : CommRing R] → (n → R) [⋀^n]→ₗ[R] R

doc:
The determinant of a matrix given by the Leibniz formula.

This is available in bundled forms as:
* `Matrix.detMonoidHom`
* `Matrix.detRowAlternating`
statement: {n : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq n] → [Fintype n] → {R : Type v} → [CommRing R] → Matrix n n R → R

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R),
  M.det = ∑ σ, Equiv.Perm.sign σ • ∏ i, M (σ i) i

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R),
  M.det = ∑ σ, ↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign σ) * ∏ i, M (σ i) i

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R),
  M.det = Matrix.detp 1 M - Matrix.detp (-1) M

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {d : n → R},
  (Matrix.diagonal d).det = ∏ i, d i

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [Nonempty n],
  Matrix.det 0 = 0
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R], Matrix.det 1 = 1

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsEmpty n]
  {A : Matrix n n R}, A.det = 1

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsEmpty n],
  Matrix.det = Function.const (Matrix n n R) 1

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {A : Matrix n n R},
  Fintype.card n = 0 → A.det = 1

doc:
If `n` has only one element, the determinant of an `n` by `n` matrix is just that element.
Although `Unique` implies `DecidableEq` and `Fintype`, the instances might
not be syntactically equal. Thus, we need to fill in the args explicitly.
statement:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Unique n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq n] [inst_3 : Fintype n]
  (A : Matrix n n R), A.det = A default default

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [Subsingleton n]
  (A : Matrix n n R) (k : n), A.det = A k k

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {A : Matrix n n R},
  Fintype.card n = 1 → ∀ (k : n), A.det = A k k

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {M N : Matrix n n R}
  {p : n → n}, ¬Function.Bijective p → ∑ σ, ↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign σ) * ∏ x, M (σ x) (p x) * N (p x) x = 0

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M N : Matrix n n R),
  (M * N).det = M.det * N.det

doc: The determinant of a matrix, as a monoid homomorphism.
statement:
{n : Type u_2} →
  [inst : DecidableEq n] → [inst_1 : Fintype n] → {R : Type v} → [inst_2 : CommRing R] → Matrix n n R →* R

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R],
  ⇑Matrix.detMonoidHom = Matrix.det

doc: On square matrices, `mul_comm` applies under `det`.
statement:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M N : Matrix m m R),
  (M * N).det = (N * M).det

doc: On square matrices, `mul_left_comm` applies under `det`.
statement:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M N P : Matrix m m R),
  (M * (N * P)).det = (N * (M * P)).det

doc: On square matrices, `mul_right_comm` applies under `det`.
statement:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M N P : Matrix m m R),
  (M * N * P).det = (M * P * N).det

∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : (Matrix m m R)ˣ)
  (N : Matrix m m R), (↑M * N * ↑M⁻¹).det = N.det

∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : (Matrix m m R)ˣ)
  (N : Matrix m m R), (↑M⁻¹ * N * ↑M).det = N.det

doc: Transposing a matrix preserves the determinant.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R),
  M.transpose.det = M.det

doc: Permuting the columns changes the sign of the determinant.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (σ : Equiv.Perm n)
  (M : Matrix n n R), (M.submatrix (⇑σ) id).det = ↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign σ) * M.det

doc: Permuting the rows changes the sign of the determinant.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (σ : Equiv.Perm n)
  (M : Matrix n n R), (M.submatrix id ⇑σ).det = ↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign σ) * M.det

doc: Permuting rows and columns with the same equivalence does not change the determinant.
statement:
∀ {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq m]
  [inst_3 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_4 : CommRing R] (e : n ≃ m) (A : Matrix m m R),
  (A.submatrix ⇑e ⇑e).det = A.det

doc:
Permuting rows and columns with two equivalences does not change the absolute value of the
determinant.
statement:
∀ {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq m]
  [inst_3 : Fintype m] {R : Type u_3} [inst_4 : CommRing R] [inst_5 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
  (e₁ e₂ : n ≃ m) (A : Matrix m m R), |(A.submatrix ⇑e₁ ⇑e₂).det| = |A.det|

doc:
Reindexing both indices along the same equivalence preserves the determinant.

For the `simp` version of this lemma, see `det_submatrix_equiv_self`; this one is unsuitable because
`Matrix.reindex_apply` unfolds `reindex` first.
statement:
∀ {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq m]
  [inst_3 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_4 : CommRing R] (e : m ≃ n) (A : Matrix m m R),
  ((Matrix.reindex e e) A).det = A.det

∀ {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq m]
  [inst_3 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_4 : CommRing R] (e e' : m ≃ n) (M : Matrix m m R),
  ((Matrix.reindex e e') M).det = ↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign (e'.trans e.symm)) * M.det

∀ {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq m]
  [inst_3 : Fintype m] {R : Type u_3} [inst_4 : CommRing R] [inst_5 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
  (e₁ e₂ : m ≃ n) (A : Matrix m m R), |((Matrix.reindex e₁ e₂) A).det| = |A.det|

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R)
  (c : R), (c • A).det = c ^ Fintype.card n * A.det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R),
  (-A).det = (-1) ^ Fintype.card n * A.det

doc:
A variant of `Matrix.det_neg` with scalar multiplication by `Units ℤ` instead of multiplication
by `R`.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R),
  (-A).det = (-1) ^ Fintype.card n • A.det

doc:
Multiplying each row by a fixed `v i` multiplies the determinant by
the product of the `v`s.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (v : n → R)
  (A : Matrix n n R), (Matrix.of fun i j => v j * A i j).det = (∏ i, v i) * A.det

doc:
Multiplying each column by a fixed `v j` multiplies the determinant by
the product of the `v`s.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (v : n → R)
  (A : Matrix n n R), (Matrix.of fun i j => v i * A i j).det = (∏ i, v i) * A.det

∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix m m R)
  (n : ℕ), (M ^ n).det = M.det ^ n

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {S : Type w}
  [inst_3 : CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (M : Matrix n n R), f M.det = (f.mapMatrix M).det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {S : Type w}
  [inst_3 : CommRing S] (f : R ≃+* S) (M : Matrix n n R), f M.det = (f.mapMatrix M).det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n ℤ),
  ↑M.det = (M.map fun x => ↑x).det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {F : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Field F] [CharZero F]
  (M : Matrix n n ℚ), ↑M.det = (M.map fun x => ↑x).det

∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [inst_3 : StarRing R]
  (M : Matrix m m R), M.conjTranspose.det = star M.det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {A : Matrix n n R}
  (i : n), (∀ (j : n), A i j = 0) → A.det = 0

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {A : Matrix n n R}
  (j : n), (∀ (i : n), A i j = 0) → A.det = 0

doc: If a matrix has a repeated row, the determinant will be zero.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {M : Matrix n n R}
  {i j : n}, i ≠ j → M i = M j → M.det = 0

doc: If a matrix has a repeated column, the determinant will be zero.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {M : Matrix n n R}
  {i j : n}, i ≠ j → (∀ (k : n), M k i = M k j) → M.det = 0

doc: If we repeat a row of a matrix, we get a matrix of determinant zero.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {M : Matrix n n R}
  {i j : n}, i ≠ j → (M.updateRow j (M i)).det = 0

doc: If we repeat a column of a matrix, we get a matrix of determinant zero.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {M : Matrix n n R}
  {i j : n}, i ≠ j → (M.updateCol j fun k => M k i).det = 0

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R)
  (j : n) (u v : n → R), (M.updateRow j (u + v)).det = (M.updateRow j u).det + (M.updateRow j v).det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R)
  (j : n) (u v : n → R), (M.updateCol j (u + v)).det = (M.updateCol j u).det + (M.updateCol j v).det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R)
  (j : n) (s : R) (u : n → R), (M.updateRow j (s • u)).det = s * (M.updateRow j u).det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R)
  (j : n) (s : R) (u : n → R), (M.updateCol j (s • u)).det = s * (M.updateCol j u).det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R)
  (j : n) (s : R) (u : n → R), ((s • M).updateRow j u).det = s ^ (Fintype.card n - 1) * (M.updateRow j u).det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R)
  (j : n) (s : R) (u : n → R), ((s • M).updateCol j u).det = s ^ (Fintype.card n - 1) * (M.updateCol j u).det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R)
  {j : n} (s : Finset n), j ∉ s → ∀ (c : n → R) (a : R), (M.updateRow j (a • M j + ∑ k ∈ s, c k • M k)).det = a • M.det

doc:
If we replace a row of a matrix by a linear combination of its rows, then the determinant is
multiplied by the coefficient of that row.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R)
  (j : n) (c : n → R), (A.updateRow j (∑ k, c k • A k)).det = c j • A.det

doc:
If we replace a column of a matrix by a linear combination of its columns, then the determinant
is multiplied by the coefficient of that column.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R)
  (j : n) (c : n → R), (A.updateCol j fun k => ∑ i, c i • A k i).det = c j • A.det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {A B : Matrix n n R}
  (C : Matrix n n R), C.det = 1 → A = B * C → A.det = B.det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {A B : Matrix n n R}
  (C : Matrix n n R), C.det = 1 → A = C * B → A.det = B.det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R)
  {i j : n}, i ≠ j → (A.updateRow i (A i + A j)).det = A.det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R)
  {i j : n}, i ≠ j → (A.updateCol i fun k => A k i + A k j).det = A.det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R)
  {i j : n}, i ≠ j → ∀ (c : R), (A.updateRow i (A i + c • A j)).det = A.det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R)
  {i j : n}, i ≠ j → ∀ (c : R), (A.updateCol i fun k => A k i + c • A k j).det = A.det

∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, (¬LinearIndependent R fun i => A i) → A.det = 0

∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, A.det ≠ 0 → LinearIndependent R fun i => A i

∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, A.det ≠ 0 → LinearIndependent R A.col

∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, (¬LinearIndependent R fun i => A.transpose i) → A.det = 0

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [Nontrivial n]
  (u v : n → R), (Matrix.vecMulVec u v).det = 0

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {A B : Matrix n n R}
  {s : Finset n} (c : n → R), (∀ i ∉ s, c i = 0) → ∀ k ∉ s, (∀ (i j : n), A i j = B i j + c i * B k j) → A.det = B.det

doc: If you add multiples of row `B k` to other rows, the determinant doesn't change.
statement:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {A B : Matrix n n R}
  (c : n → R) (k : n), c k = 0 → (∀ (i j : n), A i j = B i j + c i * B k j) → A.det = B.det

∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (k : Fin (n + 1)) (c : Fin n → R),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), k < i.succ → c i = 0) →
    ∀ {M N : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R},
      (∀ (j : Fin n.succ), M 0 j = N 0 j) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n) (j : Fin n.succ), M i.succ j = N i.succ j + c i * M i.castSucc j) → M.det = N.det

doc: If you add multiples of previous rows to the next row, the determinant doesn't change.
statement:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} {A B : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R} (c : Fin n → R),
  (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), A 0 j = B 0 j) →
    (∀ (i : Fin n) (j : Fin (n + 1)), A i.succ j = B i.succ j + c i * A i.castSucc j) → A.det = B.det

doc: If you add multiples of previous columns to the next columns, the determinant doesn't change.
statement:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} {A B : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R} (c : Fin n → R),
  (∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), A i 0 = B i 0) →
    (∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n), A i j.succ = B i j.succ + c j * A i j.castSucc) → A.det = B.det

∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {o : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : Fintype o] [inst_4 : DecidableEq o] (M : o → Matrix n n R), (Matrix.blockDiagonal M).det = ∏ k, (M k).det

doc:
The determinant of a 2×2 block matrix with the lower-left block equal to zero is the product of
the determinants of the diagonal blocks. For the generalization to any number of blocks, see
`Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular`.
statement:
∀ {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq m]
  [inst_3 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_4 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix m m R) (B : Matrix m n R) (D : Matrix n n R),
  (Matrix.fromBlocks A B 0 D).det = A.det * D.det

doc:
The determinant of a 2×2 block matrix with the upper-right block equal to zero is the product of
the determinants of the diagonal blocks. For the generalization to any number of blocks, see
`Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular`.
statement:
∀ {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq m]
  [inst_3 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_4 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix m m R) (C : Matrix n m R) (D : Matrix n n R),
  (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 C D).det = A.det * D.det

doc: Laplacian expansion of the determinant of an `n+1 × n+1` matrix along column 0.
statement:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R),
  A.det = ∑ i, (-1) ^ ↑i * A i 0 * (A.submatrix i.succAbove Fin.succ).det

doc: Laplacian expansion of the determinant of an `n+1 × n+1` matrix along row 0.
statement:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R),
  A.det = ∑ j, (-1) ^ ↑j * A 0 j * (A.submatrix Fin.succ j.succAbove).det

doc: Laplacian expansion of the determinant of an `n+1 × n+1` matrix along row `i`.
statement:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R) (i : Fin n.succ),
  A.det = ∑ j, (-1) ^ (↑i + ↑j) * A i j * (A.submatrix i.succAbove j.succAbove).det

doc: Laplacian expansion of the determinant of an `n+1 × n+1` matrix along column `j`.
statement:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R) (j : Fin n.succ),
  A.det = ∑ i, (-1) ^ (↑i + ↑j) * A i j * (A.submatrix i.succAbove j.succAbove).det

doc: Determinant of 0x0 matrix
statement: ∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {A : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 0) R}, A.det = 1

doc: Determinant of 1x1 matrix
statement: ∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] (A : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R), A.det = A 0 0
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] (a : R), !![a].det = a

doc: Determinant of 2x2 matrix
statement: ∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R), A.det = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 1 0
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] (a b c d : R), !![a, b; c, d].det = a * d - b * c

doc: Determinant of 3x3 matrix
statement:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R),
  A.det =
    A 0 0 * A 1 1 * A 2 2 - A 0 0 * A 1 2 * A 2 1 - A 0 1 * A 1 0 * A 2 2 + A 0 1 * A 1 2 * A 2 0 +
        A 0 2 * A 1 0 * A 2 1 -
      A 0 2 * A 1 1 * A 2 0
